title: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A compleated planeswalker and storyteller who reads a cursed scroll over Towashi and shatters Boseiju until she is cut down by the Wanderer.

entities.name: Tamiyo's memory
entities.description: A being of floating characters created by Tamiyo years ago and sealed in a scroll, which survives as her memory and speaks with her old warmth.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who rescues a boy and his dog in Towashi and who must pull the Gatewatch together.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker defending Kamigawa, who takes Nashi up Boseiju to face Tamiyo and whose telekinesis saves Kaya.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A young nezumi who tries to reach his mother Tamiyo and who survives her fall.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A white-haired planeswalker and emperor of Kamigawa bound to Kyodai, who strikes down Tamiyo.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: The guardian spirit of Kamigawa whose soul is bound to the emperor.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A great wizard in the story Tamiyo recites, who created Karn.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother and rival in the story of the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A metal heir created by Urza who shaped a plane.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Karn's successor who oversaw the created plane and was tainted by oil in the story.

entities.name: Eiko
entities.description: Kaito's sister whom he compares to Tamiyo's family.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who was supposed to hold Ravnica down.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who was to coordinate the other planes.

entities.name: Teyo
entities.description: A planeswalker defending Ravnica.

entities.name: Ral
entities.description: A planeswalker who prepared countermeasures for Ravnica.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler whose skeletal branches strike Kamigawa.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane of neon and spirits under Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A city plane also under attack.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The compleated plane of the invaders.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: The neon-lit Kamigawan city being destroyed.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: The great tree over Towashi that once held the plane together and is shattered by Tamiyo's reading.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: A place where Kaito met Tamiyo.

entities.name: The kami
entities.description: Spirits of Kamigawa who are torn from their homes and dissolved by the invasion.

entities.name: Tamiyo's scroll
entities.description: A scroll bound by an iron ring containing the story of Phyrexia's victory, which Tamiyo reads over Towashi.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The Phyrexian World Tree whose branches strike Kamigawa.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker alliance Kaya must gather.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde invading Kamigawa.

entities.name: Imperial forces
entities.description: Kamigawan imperial forces with mechs gathering to counter the assault.

events.summary: Tamiyo hovers over Towashi, removing the iron ring from the scroll she wrote and reading it as the Phyrexian assault begins.
events.quote: Hovering over the neon skies of Towashi, she holds the scroll in hand.

events.summary: Tamiyo reads the story of Urza, Karn and Memnarch, and her words shake Towashi, collapsing buildings and etching Phyrexian symbols.
events.quote: Each syllable she reads booms and reverberates, shaking the skyscrapers of Towashi.

events.summary: Boseiju bursts apart and oil pours from it, killing and dissolving the kami.
events.quote: Boseiju, the tree that once held this plane together, bursts apart.

events.summary: The scroll turns to oil in Tamiyo's hands as the story ends with Phyrexia's victory.
events.quote: This is how the story ends, and how it has always ended: with Phyrexia's victory.

events.summary: Kaya helps Kaito defend Kamigawa and phases through a wall to find a trapped boy and his dog.
events.quote: A young boy and his dog quiver in the corner on the other side.

events.summary: Kaya pulls the boy and dog free and leaps with them from a collapsing building, but the balcony falls away.
events.quote: Kaya, the boy, and the dog plummet.

events.summary: Kaito saves Kaya and the boy by slowing their fall with telekinesis.
events.quote: His telekinesis is barely holding them up

events.summary: Kaito tells Kaya that Tamiyo has opened the scroll and is destroying Boseiju.
events.quote: And worse, Tamiyo did it. Opened a scroll.

events.summary: Kaito starts to climb Boseiju to confront Tamiyo and meets Nashi, who asks to try to reach his mother.
events.quote: That's my mom up there.

events.summary: Kaito gives Nashi a repulsor and they climb Boseiju together toward Tamiyo.
events.quote: Walk in the direction you want to go.

events.summary: Nashi calls to Tamiyo, who answers with his name before her body snaps around and she attacks.
events.quote: A shard of metal shoots toward them

events.summary: Tamiyo urges Nashi to join Phyrexia, and Kaito tells him to retreat as they fight.
events.quote: In the light of New Phyrexia, all are one.

events.summary: Tamiyo overpowers Kaito with scrolls and hangs him above Towashi, offering him surrender.
events.quote: Kaito flips feet over head before he knows what's happened, dangling far above Towashi.

events.summary: Kaito cuts himself free and is caught by Kyodai bearing the Wanderer.
events.quote: it's the emperor.

events.summary: The Wanderer confronts Tamiyo, who holds Nashi and takes out the scroll bound by an iron band.
events.quote: Tamiyo reaches for a scroll at her waist, one bound with an iron band.

events.summary: Empowered by Kyodai, the Wanderer cuts Tamiyo down.
events.quote: Tamiyo falls.

events.summary: Nashi, grieving, is comforted by Kaito, Kaya, the Wanderer and Kyodai.
events.quote: Even Kyodai wraps around them all.

events.summary: Tamiyo's memory, a being of floating characters, speaks and reveals she was sealed in the scroll for such a death.
events.quote: I am what remains of Tamiyo—her story unending.

events.summary: The Wanderer explains that Tamiyo's last act was a request that her missed shards and mouthed words showed, so the memory is true.
events.quote: Tamiyo was making a request, in the only way she could.

events.summary: Imperial forces with giant mechs gather to counter the Phyrexian assault as Kaito reflects that Tamiyo fell but Nashi lived.
events.quote: Tamiyo fell—but Nashi lived.

relations.note: Karn appoints Memnarch as his successor to oversee his plane
